Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Platform
Globex Financial — London, UK (Hybrid, 2 days in office). Visa sponsorship available for the right candidate.

About the role
You will design and run the APIs that power card and bank payments for millions of customers. You'll work in a small platform team, own services end to end, and help raise engineering standards across the company.

What you'll do
- Build and operate high-throughput REST APIs and event-driven services
- Improve reliability, latency and observability of payment flows
- Design data models and optimise queries in PostgreSQL
- Mentor mid-level engineers and review code
- Run services on Kubernetes and manage infrastructure with Terraform

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally in payments or fintech
- Strong Node.js and TypeScript
- Deep experience with PostgreSQL and performance tuning
- Production experience with Kubernetes and AWS
- Experience designing REST APIs and microservices
- Excellent communication and a track record of mentoring others

Nice to have
- Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code
- Knowledge of PCI-DSS and secure payment handling
- Experience with Kafka or other message queues
